viewing_check: Armitage estimate 30-60, current bid $60 (rechecked; bid has risen from $40 and is already at the top of the estimate). About 42 plain clear jars, no lids, Fowlers name not seen on any jar in the photos. Comparable Fowlers Vacola jar lots sold A$36 to 114 on eBay AU in 2024-2025, mostly with lids, clips or scarce sizes; a plain 35-jar lot made A$84.93. At $60 plus 22% premium (about $73) the lot is already near that. Bulky: 42 jars, pickup only realistically. Andy should check whether the jars are embossed Fowlers and whether lids/clips are included. Prices are 1 to 2 years old, flat.
